scopes: lodgings used for a single night
lodgings used for several nights
options: clothes hung immediately on arrival
clothes kept in labeled packing rolls
clothes arranged in a shallow drawer
clothes folded on an open luggage shelf
opener: I arrived with my socks somehow mixed in with the chargers.
distraction: The hallway smelled faintly of fresh wood.

scopes: ferry trips made without a camera
ferry trips made with a camera
options: a pencil rubbing of the ticket stamp
a tiny sketch of the wake
a written note about the crossing sounds
a pressed scrap from the onboard leaflet
opener: The crossing was bumpier than the leaflet made it look.
distraction: My hat nearly escaped when I stepped outside.
